scenarios.title: A｜对方也喜欢自己
scenarios.setting: 两个人已经约会过几次，玩家决定表达自己的感受。

turns.text: I’ve really enjoyed spending time with you lately.
Me too. I’ve had a really good time with you.

turns.prompt: 你想说说自己的感受或状态，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I really like you, and I feel like there’s something between us.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really like you, and I feel like there’s something between us.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: I think I’m starting to really like you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’m starting to really like you.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I wasn’t sure whether to say this, but I like you as more than a friend.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t sure whether to say this, but I like you as more than a friend.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: I feel really comfortable around you, and I’d like to see where this goes.

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel really comfortable around you, and I’d like to see where this goes.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I have a good feeling for you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really like you, and I feel like there’s something between us.
feedback.explanation: “have a good feeling”更像对事情有预感；表达对一个人有好感，可说“I have feelings for you”。

turns.text: I’m glad you said that. I really like you too.

turns.prompt: 你想表达发现彼此心意一致的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Really? I’m glad we’re on the same page.

feedback.naturalExpression: Really? I’m glad we’re on the same page.
feedback.explanation: “on the same page”表示理解一致；用来核对双方是否形成共识。

choices.text: That’s good to hear. I wasn’t sure how you felt.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s good to hear. I wasn’t sure how you felt.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I’m really happy to hear that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really happy to hear that.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Well, that makes this conversation a lot easier!

feedback.naturalExpression: Well, that makes this conversation a lot easier!
feedback.explanation: 承接对方同样有好感的答复，用轻松语气表达松了一口气。

turns.text: I was actually thinking about telling you the same thing.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方也曾想主动表白，会怎么说？

choices.text: Then I’m glad I said it first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then I’m glad I said it first.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: I guess we were both thinking the same thing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I guess we were both thinking the same thing.
feedback.explanation: “I guess”表示自己的推测，语气比直接断言更轻。

choices.text: Maybe we should go on another date soon, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should go on another date soon, then.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: B｜对方不确定
scenarios.setting: 在“表达好感”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方不确定”。

turns.text: I wanted to be honest with you. I really like you.
I like spending time with you too, but I’m not completely sure what I want right now.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s okay. I appreciate you being honest with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. I appreciate you being honest with me.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I understand. You don’t have to decide anything right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. You don’t have to decide anything right now.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: That’s fair. Would you rather just take things slowly?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. Would you rather just take things slowly?
feedback.explanation: “take things”与“slowly”等搭配时表示关系发展的节奏，适合商量不要进展太快。

choices.text: Thanks for telling me. I don’t want you to feel pressured.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for telling me. I don’t want you to feel pressured.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Why aren’t you sure? Don’t you like me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. I appreciate you being honest with me.
feedback.explanation: 连问是否不喜欢自己会让对方觉得需要证明感情；尊重尚不确定的答复，更能保留交流空间。

turns.text: I do like you. I just don’t want to rush into anything.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. I’m okay with taking things slowly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. I’m okay with taking things slowly.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s fine with me. We can just see how things develop.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine with me. We can just see how things develop.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I don’t want to rush things either.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to rush things either.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: Okay. Just let me know if your feelings change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Just let me know if your feelings change.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

scenarios.title: C｜被拒绝
scenarios.setting: 在“表达好感”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“被拒绝”。

turns.text: There’s something I’ve been wanting to tell you. I like you as more than a friend.
I’m really sorry. I care about you, but I don’t feel the same way.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. Thanks for being honest with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Thanks for being honest with me.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s okay. I appreciate you telling me directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. I appreciate you telling me directly.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I’m disappointed, obviously, but I respect how you feel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m disappointed, obviously, but I respect how you feel.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I understand. I might need a little time, though.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. I might need a little time, though.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Why don’t you like me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Thanks for being honest with me.
feedback.explanation: 直接追问为什么不喜欢自己，容易让对方觉得必须为拒绝辩解；接受对方的感受，更能尊重这次答复。

turns.text: I hope this doesn’t ruin our friendship.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对友情的顾虑，同时说明自己需要的空间，会怎么说？

choices.text: I hope not either. I just might need some space for a little while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hope not either. I just might need some space for a little while.
feedback.explanation: “need some space”表示需要个人空间或暂时分开冷静，能说明需求而不评价对方这个人。

choices.text: I still value our friendship. I just need some time to process this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still value our friendship. I just need some time to process this.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Don’t worry. I’m glad we talked about it honestly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry. I’m glad we talked about it honestly.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: I can’t promise things will feel normal immediately, but I understand.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t promise things will feel normal immediately, but I understand.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: Of course. Take whatever time you need.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for understanding.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
